Class Product

java.lang.Object
market.Product
Direct Known Subclasses:
FruitVegetable
public abstract class Product extends Object
Generate a product with a name, the price with unit, the quantity, the harvest date and the number of days to keep. We can calculate the expiration date and update the product.
Author:
RocancourtM
